rule.formula: if(size == 2, if(width == supplierWidth && height == supplierHeight, (if(quantity == 500, supplierCustom500, if(quantity == 1000, supplierCustom1000, if(quantity == 2500, supplierCustom2500, supplierCustom5000)))) * supplierMultiplier, 0) + design * designFee, (if(size == 0, if(quantity == 500, halfq500, if(quantity == 1000, halfq1000, if(quantity == 2500, halfq2500, halfq5000))), if(size == 1, if(quantity == 500, fullq500, if(quantity == 1000, fullq1000, if(quantity == 2500, fullq2500, fullq5000))), if(quantity == 500, customq500, if(quantity == 1000, customq1000, if(quantity == 2500, customq2500, customq5000)))))) + if(size != 2, print_sides * backSide, 0) + design * designFee)
